```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(xts)
library(GGally)
```

```{r force data import}

# create a list of data frames
df_list = list()

# processed force profile pathdir
profile_path = "../../../data/processed/excavation_data/processed_force_profiles/prop_adair/"

file_names = dir(profile_path)
for(file_name in file_names){
        path = paste(profile_path, file_name, sep='')
        df = fread(file = path)
        df_list[[file_name]] = df
}
```

```{r peak_force_values}
# Create an empty data frame with names and column types
df_force = data.frame(
        sys_id = character(0),
        ang45_ang = numeric(0),
        ang45_n = numeric(0),
        peak_ang = numeric(0),
        peak_n = numeric(0),
        peak45_ang = numeric(0),
        peak45_n = numeric(0)
)

# populate the data frame
for(name in names(df_list)){
        ang45_idx = min(which(df_list[[name]]$ang_y <= 45))
        ang45_row = df_list[[name]][ang45_idx,]

        peak_idx = which.max(df_list[[name]]$std_trunk_effort_n)
        peak_row = df_list[[name]][peak_idx,]
        
        peak45_idx = which.max(df_list[[name]][1:ang45_idx]$std_trunk_effort_n)
        peak45_row = df_list[[name]][peak45_idx,]

        df_force <- df_force %>%
                add_row(
                        tibble_row(
                                sys_id=substr(toupper(name), start=1, stop=nchar(name)-4),
                                ang45_ang=ang45_row$ang_y,
                                ang45_n=ang45_row$std_trunk_effort_n,
                                peak_ang=peak_row$ang_y,
                                peak_n=peak_row$std_trunk_effort_n,
                                peak45_ang=peak45_row$ang_y,
                                peak45_n=peak45_row$std_trunk_effort_n
                        )
                )
}

```

```{r radial density maps}
# radial density maps
rad_den_path = "../../../data/processed/radial_density_maps/prop_adair/"
rad_filenames = dir(rad_den_path)
rad_den_list = list()

for(file_name in rad_filenames){
        path = paste(rad_den_path, file_name, sep='')
        rad_den_df = fread(path) %>% 
                arrange(radius, angle)
        tree_row = str_extract(file_name, '^\\d{2}[EW]+')
        tree = str_extract(tree_row, "^\\d{2}")
        row = paste("17", str_extract(tree_row, "[EW]{1}"), sep="")
        sys_id = paste(row, tree, sep="_")
        rad_den_list[[sys_id]] <- rad_den_df

}

degrees_radius_map <- rad_den_df[,3:4]

den_mat <- matrix(nrow=0, ncol=2700)
sys_id_labels = c()
for(idx in names(rad_den_list)){
        
        vec <- as.vector(rad_den_list[[idx]]$density)
        den_mat <- rbind(den_mat, vec)
        sys_id_labels <- c(sys_id_labels, idx)
}
sys_id_labels <- data.frame(sys_id=sys_id_labels)

sys_id_labels <- sys_id_labels %>% 
        left_join(df_force, by='sys_id')

# get rows of complete cases
c_idx <- complete.cases(sys_id_labels)
density_df <- cbind(sys_id_labels, den_mat)[c_idx,]
col_names <- c(colnames(density_df[1:7]), paste("D", as.character(1:2700), sep='.'))
colnames(density_df) <- col_names
# den_mat <- den_mat[c_idx,]
# sys_id_labels <- sys_id_labels[c_idx,]

write.csv(density_df, file='../../../data/processed/radial_density_maps/prop_adair_densities.csv')
```


```{r join forces to metadata}
meta <- fread('../../../metadata/join_tables/prop_adair_join_table.csv')
growth <- fread('../../../data/raw/tree_growth/prop_adair_tree_growth_data.csv') %>% 
        filter(t==2)
sys_measurment <- fread('../../../data/raw/whole_root_system_measurements/prop_adair_root_system_measurement.csv')
root_summaries <- fread('../../../data/processed/root_measurements/prop_adair_root_measurement_summary.csv')
force_results <- df_force %>% 
        left_join(meta, by='sys_id') %>%
        dplyr::select(-comment) %>% 
        left_join(growth, by='sys_id') %>% 
        dplyr::select(-ends_with(".y")) %>% 
        left_join(sys_measurment, by='sys_id') %>% 
        # dplyr::select(-ends_with(".x")) %>% 
        left_join(root_summaries, by='sys_id') %>% 
        rename('rs'='rs.x', 
               'prop_type'='prop_type.x')
        # dplyr::select(-c(ends_with(".y"), ends_with(".x"), V1))

num_data <- force_results %>% 
        dplyr::select(-c(sys_id, ang45_ang, peak_ang, peak45_ang, measurement_date, t, direction:block))

write.csv(force_results, "../../../data/processed/excavation_data/peak_force_tree_measurements.csv")

```

```{r plsr modeling}
D_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(density_df[,8:2007])) %>% 
        mutate(peak_n = density_df$peak45_n) %>% 
        select(peak_n, everything())
pls_formula <- formula(D_scaled)
peak_pls <- plsr(pls_formula, ncomp = 100, data = density_df, validation="LOO")
plot(scores(peak_pls))

plot(peak_pls)
plot(peak_pls, ncomp = 1 ,plottype = "coef")
plot(peak_pls, plottype = "correlation")
plot(explvar(peak_pls))
plot(cumsum(explvar(peak_pls)))
```
